## Intent

List the Kniffel-Trainer in the catalog, as the last step of the first interactive spike of the compact guidance, in which a separate session builds an app with the creator from the build prompt to the listing.

## Key changes

- A catalog entry for the Kniffel-Trainer (Yahtzee Trainer): Mathematik for grades 7 and 8, at https://mrsimpson.github.io/kniffel-trainer/, in German and English.
- Learners play Yahtzee and work out chances as fractions and percentages.
- Three topics: explain mode with coach and tree, game with joker, plain game with high scores.
- Fitness: no account, no install, storage on the device, no third parties.
- The creator is Oliver, linked to his GitHub profile.
